blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY – Pacific Partnership 2026 (PP26), a multinational humanitarian assistance and disaster preparedness mission, has returned to Tacloban City for a 12-day engagement focused on strengthening disaster response, medical cooperation and community resilience.
